question: Which of the following bones does NOT contain paranasal sinuses ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Sphenoids -> contain paranasal sinuses -> FALSE -> 95% CHAIN: Ethmoid -> contain paranasal sinuses -> TRUE -> 95% CHAIN: Zygomatic -> contain paranasal sinuses -> FALSE -> 95% CHAIN: Frontal -> contain paranasal sinuses -> TRUE -> 95%
analysis: Paranasal sinuses are air-filled spaces within the bones of the skull. The zygomatic bone does not contain paranasal sinuses.
